author: raziki9
body:
Hey,
I have been banned from your server well...
you see, I used hacks... or did I?
Mr. PelThePenguin had banned me from the server for Anti Knock-back hacks...
Did I use them? yes. Do I regret it? yes. Will I do it again? If you don't tell my mom. jk <3
Why am I appealing?
Simple answer it is... Well you see I also used fly hacks its an underestimation of my amazing skills... I would very much love to be re-banned but to add flying as well and if you're at it... be sure to add my always have a critical hit and if you so wish my bow aimbot
thank you <3
Now for my real appeal ^dats random crap
I have been banned for hacking which I admit doing though I promise not to do it again...
you see I have loved this server for a long time and I still do its amazing i especially love the nebula...
Why did I hack than?
I'm a scrub at nebula I thought I could use some help you see...
not everyone can play good yet fair some resort to less likely ways thus did I learn to do the same while seeing many unpunished hackers on this server seeing nothing happens to them!
I thought what if i do the same... will I get banned...? it seemed like I wouldn't be I hope thy understands and would let me back into the server... I love it here and would love to back,
sincerely,
your friendly (non-hacking)
raziki9 <3 :D
